all.effect_identity: parent effect id plus the deterministic seed-local, seed-host, push-kv, reseed-azure, and verify child effect ids
all.prepare: Persist the complete ordered child graph and all resolved resource identities before the first mutation.
all.reconciliation: Reconcile each child independently and continue only from the first NOT_APPLIED child; any INDETERMINATE child keeps the parent INDETERMINATE and prevents a duplicate write.

mint.reconciliation: Replay-safe; emits the fixed mint instructions and performs no credential read or mutation.

push-kv.effect_identity: resolved vault resource id plus fixed secret names plus source credential/config fingerprints
push-kv.prepare: Persist the vault resource id, fixed secret names, source fingerprints, and pre-write secret version ids before upload.
push-kv.reconciliation: Key Vault metadata tags bind each new version to effect_id and the non-secret source fingerprint. Matching enabled versions are ALREADY_APPLIED; unchanged pre-write versions are NOT_APPLIED; divergent or partially updated secret versions are INDETERMINATE.

reseed-azure.effect_identity: resolved deployment id plus authenticated reseed request id plus expected Key Vault version ids
reseed-azure.prepare: Persist deployment id, request id, and expected vault versions before the authenticated reseed call.
reseed-azure.reconciliation: Query the authenticated reseed/status surfaces. A receipt for request id followed by remote Claude status valid and a credential file version at least the expected vault version is ALREADY_APPLIED; explicit absence with the old remote version is NOT_APPLIED; timeout without queryable receipt or conflicting versions is INDETERMINATE.

seed-host.effect_identity: host credential provider slot plus source credential fingerprint plus operating-system target kind
seed-host.prepare: Persist the provider slot id, OS target kind, and non-secret source fingerprint before mutation.
seed-host.reconciliation: The provider compares the installed credential fingerprint and runs the bounded exact host AUTH_OK probe. Match plus pass is ALREADY_APPLIED; proved prior fingerprint is NOT_APPLIED; disagreement or an unreadable post-write slot is INDETERMINATE.

seed-local.effect_identity: resolved container id plus fixed credential path plus source credential fingerprint plus optional config fingerprint
seed-local.prepare: Persist the resolved container identity and non-secret source fingerprints before any copy.
seed-local.reconciliation: Hash the installed credential/config inside the same container and run the bounded exact AUTH_OK probe. Matching fingerprints and a passing probe are ALREADY_APPLIED; proved old fingerprints are NOT_APPLIED; a replaced container, partial fingerprint match, or conflicting target is INDETERMINATE.

status.reconciliation: Replay the typed local, host, and vault status probes; absence is an explicit observed state, never a skipped success.

verify.reconciliation: Replay every selected bounded probe and retain its typed result; no selected target may be silently skipped.

policy.dry_run_rule: dry_run=true performs no credential read or mutation and terminalizes only as DRY_RUN, never APPLIED.
policy.secret_rule: Credential contents never enter argv, logs, journal events, terminal artifacts, or error text. The owner may retain only a non-secret content SHA-256 and provider/resource version identifiers.

command_specific.all: Every required child effect is semantically successful in order, remote Claude verification passes, temporary secret material owned by the effect is deleted, and the parent emits one terminal event.
command_specific.mint: The fixed operator instructions are emitted and no credential source was accessed.
command_specific.push-kv: The credential secret version and, when supplied, config secret version exist, are enabled, carry this effect id, and match the non-secret source fingerprints; config absence is explicit when no config was supplied.
command_specific.reseed-azure: The authenticated reseed receipt matches request id and remote Claude credential status is valid with the expected source version; generic HTTP health is insufficient.
command_specific.seed-host: The installed host credential fingerprint matches the prepared source and the exact host Claude probe returns AUTH_OK within 60 seconds.
command_specific.seed-local: Installed fingerprints match the prepared sources in the resolved container and its exact Claude probe returns AUTH_OK within 60 seconds.
command_specific.status: Typed observations exist for every requested/required status surface, including explicit PRESENT, ABSENT, VALID, INVALID, UNREACHABLE, or NOT_CONFIGURED states; success means the report is complete, not that credentials are valid.
command_specific.verify: Every selected target returns its exact semantic pass marker; a missing CLI, stopped container, unreachable remote, or skipped probe fails verification.

integrate-remote-and-resume.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus original effect commit plus fetched remote head plus merge base plus manifest hash
integrate-remote-and-resume.prepare: Persist the fetched remote head, merge base, authorized scope, original commit identity, and pre-rebase repository snapshot before rebase.
integrate-remote-and-resume.reconciliation: Use Git rebase state plus effect trailer, parent lineage, exact manifest delta, and remote head. A completed exact integrated commit is ALREADY_APPLIED; fully restored original state is NOT_APPLIED; partial/conflicting rebase or scope drift is INDETERMINATE and must fail closed.

isolated-integrate-and-resume.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus source commit/state hash plus fetched remote head plus manifest/overlay/message hashes
isolated-integrate-and-resume.prepare: Persist source snapshot, remote snapshot, deterministic isolated commit metadata, and temporary-workspace identity before cloning.
isolated-integrate-and-resume.reconciliation: Query the remote for the exact effect trailer and authorized tree delta. A matching remote head with unchanged source is ALREADY_APPLIED; unchanged remote/source with no effect commit is NOT_APPLIED; remote advance, conflicting effect marker, or changed source is INDETERMINATE.

isolated-reconcile-and-resume.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus source commit/state hash plus fetched remote head/merge base plus manifest/overlay hashes plus canonical ledger event-id set hash
isolated-reconcile-and-resume.prepare: Persist source and remote snapshots, approved semantic paths, canonical ledger identities, and deterministic isolated commit metadata before reconciliation.
isolated-reconcile-and-resume.reconciliation: Require the exact effect-marked remote commit, authorized tree delta, canonical ledger union, regenerated blocker view, and byte-identical source snapshot for ALREADY_APPLIED. Unchanged remote/source with no effect commit is NOT_APPLIED; any semantic, remote, or source disagreement is INDETERMINATE.

publish.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus repository identity plus initial HEAD plus branch plus remote-url hash plus manifest/content hash plus approved message hash
publish.local_reconciliation: If HEAD is the prepared initial HEAD and the index is empty, the local mutation is NOT_APPLIED. If HEAD is one direct child carrying the exact Prevention-Effect-ID trailer, approved message, parent, author/committer policy, and manifest-only tree delta, it is ALREADY_APPLIED_LOCAL. Any other HEAD/index/scope state is INDETERMINATE.
publish.prepare: Persist all identity fields, source/index/worktree snapshots, deterministic effect trailer, and authorization consumption before git add.
publish.remote_reconciliation: Resolve the remote branch head. Exact equality to the identified local effect commit is ALREADY_APPLIED_REMOTE; the prepared prior remote head with local effect commit retained is NOT_APPLIED_REMOTE; remote advance, missing effect commit, or conflicting effect marker is INDETERMINATE.

resume-push.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus repository identity plus exact effect-marked HEAD commit plus branch and remote-url hash
resume-push.reconciliation: Require the exact prepared effect commit at HEAD, empty index, and unchanged authorized identities; reconcile the remote branch exactly as publish without creating another commit.

policy.resume_rule: Continue only the first NOT_APPLIED stage. Never create a second effect-marked commit or push after ALREADY_APPLIED_REMOTE; every INDETERMINATE state stops without force push, reset, stash, or destructive cleanup.

stage_reconciliation.qualification: A matching child terminal artifact plus same-bundle verification_recorded and passed run_closed events is ALREADY_APPLIED; no child preparation/evidence is NOT_APPLIED; partial or conflicting ledger evidence is INDETERMINATE.
stage_reconciliation.readiness: Recompute readiness metadata and bundle hash. Exact derived readiness is ALREADY_APPLIED; unchanged metadata is NOT_APPLIED; unexplained bundle drift is INDETERMINATE.
stage_reconciliation.registered_verification: A matching typed child terminal artifact plus registered same-bundle same-path verification and passed close is ALREADY_APPLIED; absence is NOT_APPLIED; partial/conflicting evidence is INDETERMINATE.

status.reconciliation: Replay discovery_state and registered state reads against the same discovery id, sequence id, source bundle hash, registry hash, and ledger head; return explicit stage and blocker/correction state.

command_specific.correct: The deterministic correction exists once with the exact changed-artifact hashes; bundle transition and failed-run closure match; the blocker is fixed-awaiting-verification; next_stage is successor-verification. This does not claim the blocker verified or closed.
command_specific.correct-registered: The same correction evidence holds for the registered subject and next_stage is successor-verification. This does not claim the blocker verified or closed.
command_specific.drive: Stage is complete; the target registered sequence and manifest exist at the expected bundle hash; registry and promotion events match; a passed registered same-path child verification and run closure exist for that hash; and no open blocker or pending correction takes precedence.
command_specific.status: Exactly one recognized stage is returned with discovery id, sequence id, source bundle hash, ledger hash, registered-verification state, open blockers, and pending correction identities; success means a complete observation, not lifecycle completion.

common: The process return code is zero.
The output validates against the command-specific schema and has ok=true.
The semantic verifier reloads the exact source bundle, registry, ledger, promotion journal, blocker state, and child terminal artifacts required by the command.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and matching terminal artifact exist for effect_id.
source_corrections: Replace direct execution of a shlex-parsed Markdown verification command with typed child-owner dispatch and a journaled child receipt.
Make max_qualification_runs owner-fixed at three and reserve each drive transition progressively instead of accepting a caller-controlled bound.
Replace arbitrary root/path strings and flat changed-artifact lines with the materialized repository-key/path schema.
Emit one structured owner terminal artifact after semantic re-observation rather than terminalizing from the controller return code alone.
Preserve the correction predecessor's task identity for its verification successor and tolerate unrelated legacy run-start records without weakening predecessor ownership checks.

trusted_roots.repository-root-registry: A content-addressed manifest that maps only configured repository keys to approved canonical roots

derivation: The owner materializes each next task or parallel frontier from durable program state.
The owner derives every UnitBudget; callers provide no budget values.
Every task in a frontier is fully reserved before any frontier member launches.
If capacity is insufficient, the parent persists a paused checkpoint before effects and resumes from that checkpoint after capacity is available.
The parent reservation is released only after semantic terminalization or a durable stopped/failed result.

admission_rules: Resolve repository_key through the configured remote repository registry; reject raw local paths and unregistered slugs.
Resolve every host file from an approved root key plus a relative path; reject absolute paths, traversal, and resolved symlink escape.
skip_build requires a semantic image-label/source-hash verifier to pass before admission.
skip_auth requires live Codex and GitRemoteManager capability probes to pass before admission.
Remove the legacy restore_checkpoint host-path mode; current durable program state explicitly rejects legacy /tmp checkpoint authority.
create-program, resume-program, and validate-fresh pass the durable decomposition/program identities now required by workflow.greenfield.driveDag.
validate-fresh is a checkpoint-resume profile with a fixed round-0 smoke; callers cannot combine it with create-program or reuse the durable validation ledger.

effect_identity: spec hash when starting from spec
decomposition task id and run id once created
durable stage-operation ids for every launched child
policy.execution_model: The prevention adapter orchestrates typed child tasks and durable receipts; it does not execute greenfield_full_drive.sh as one opaque subprocess.

reconciliation.before_workflow_identity: Reconcile completed infrastructure child receipts through the approved local-workflow-orch-image contract; launch only the first missing child.
reconciliation.fresh_validation: The validate-fresh profile reconciles the same durable program identity as resume-program, but success additionally requires a persisted validationResult.fresh=true from a newly executed round-0 smoke.
reconciliation.n1_or_n2_identity_known: Query the durable workflow run by task/run identity. Active or terminal matching work is ALREADY_APPLIED; a proved-absent deterministic identity is NOT_APPLIED; conflicts are INDETERMINATE.
reconciliation.parallel_frontier: Every child has a deterministic stage operation id and durable start intent. Reconcile each child independently; never relaunch an acknowledged matching child and never launch an unreserved sibling.
reconciliation.program_identity_known: Call workflow.greenfield.driveStatus with decompositionTaskId and programDriveId. running, stopped, completed, or failed proves ALREADY_APPLIED and selects monitor/terminal handling without relaunch. PROGRAM_DRIVE_NOT_FOUND is NOT_APPLIED only when no acknowledged program-created receipt exists; otherwise it is INDETERMINATE.

policy.failure: driveStatus status stopped or failed, a conflicting durable identity, a semantic child failure, or a budget/root/schema violation produces one failed terminal event with evidence and never success.
policy.launch_is_not_terminal: A zero exit or sequence-complete marker after detached launch leaves the parent STARTED.
success_requirements: status is completed and lastDurableTransition is program_completed.
programDriveId, decompositionTaskId, decompositionRunId, repositoryKey, targetBranch, specHash, and universeHash match the prepared effect identity.
executionOrder has at most 20 unique nodes, its set equals mergedNodes, and every featureStates entry has status covered with a nonempty mergeSha.
validationResult.verdict is validated; validation_skipped is not semantic success for this full-drive owner.
For validate-fresh, validationResult.fresh is true and the validation terminal transition records fresh=true.
requirementCoverage.terminalDecision.status is covered, or not_required only when the durable required-acceptance set is empty.
The authenticated remote target-branch head equals mergedBaseSha.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and matching terminal artifact exist for effect_id; identical replay returns the existing event and conflicting replay fails closed.

trusted_roots.remote-repository-registry: The configured repository mapping consumed by GitRemoteManager

contract.derivation: Eight separately scheduled atomic tasks at the approved 3600000 millisecond per-task cap. Retries remain inside the productive task cap and receive no separate reservation.

path_rules: Reject absolute caller paths; accept a root key plus a relative path only.
Resolve symlinks and prove containment in the named trusted root before argv construction.
For write targets, resolve and validate the nearest existing parent before creation.
Never read, persist, hash, or print secret-handle contents in the prevention controller.

build.already_applied: The tag resolves to an image whose prevention effect-id label equals effect_id.
build.effect_identity: effect_id plus image tag plus pre-execution image id plus build-context source hash
build.implementation_requirement: Pass a prevention effect-id label to docker build.
build.indeterminate: The tag resolves to a different image without the expected effect-id label.
build.not_applied: The tag is absent or still resolves to the prepared pre-execution image id.

copy-code-project.already_applied: The final destination has the expected effect receipt and source hash.
copy-code-project.effect_identity: effect_id plus container id plus source repository key and source hash plus destination
copy-code-project.implementation_requirement: Copy into an effect-specific staging directory, perform all git configuration there, write an effect receipt, then atomically rename into the final destination.
copy-code-project.indeterminate: A staging directory, conflicting destination, or mismatched receipt exists.
copy-code-project.not_applied: Neither final receipt nor effect staging directory exists.

run.already_applied: The named container exists with the expected effect-id label and declared image and port binding.
run.effect_identity: effect_id plus requested container name plus prepared pre-execution container id
run.implementation_requirement: Reject an existing same-name container unless it carries the local-workflow-orch-image owner label; record any accepted prior container id before removal; pass owner and prevention effect-id labels to docker run.
run.indeterminate: The name is occupied by a container without the expected effect-id label.
run.not_applied: The accepted prepared container still exists, or its authorized removal completed but no replacement container exists; replay can safely create the labeled replacement.

seed-codex-auth.already_applied: A live, non-secret Codex no-tool probe returns the exact approved OK marker.
seed-codex-auth.effect_identity: effect_id plus container id plus Key Vault name handle; no secret material
seed-codex-auth.indeterminate: Credential files exist but the live probe does not prove usable authentication.
seed-codex-auth.not_applied: Required credential/config files are definitively absent.

seed-git-auth.already_applied: The restarted service is healthy, uses GitRemoteManager, and a non-mutating authenticated URL acquisition probe succeeds for repository_key without emitting credentials.
seed-git-auth.effect_identity: effect_id plus container id plus Key Vault name handle plus repository key
seed-git-auth.indeterminate: Files exist but health, manager type, or authenticated acquisition is not proven.
seed-git-auth.not_applied: Required GitHub App configuration or PEM files are definitively absent.

stop.already_applied: The prepared container id no longer exists.
stop.effect_identity: effect_id plus prepared container id and name
stop.implementation_requirement: Reject a same-name container that lacks the local-workflow-orch-image owner label before removal.
stop.indeterminate: The name now refers to a different container id.
stop.not_applied: The prepared container id still exists under the prepared name.

by_command.build: JSON ok is true, imageTag equals the request, and docker inspect proves the expected effect-id label.
by_command.copy-code-project: JSON ok is true and non-mutating container checks prove the receipt, source hash, safe-directory entries, and local origin value.
by_command.health: JSON ok is true, port agrees with the request or port file, and health.status is exactly ok.
by_command.logs: docker logs succeeds; the owner emits a structured envelope containing ok=true and a hash of captured log bytes, never success after an ignored Docker error.
by_command.probe-codex: JSON ok is true; exactly the noTool and tool probes exist; both return code zero and each output matches its exact approved OK marker.
by_command.require-real-memory-knowledge: JSON ok and realMemoryKnowledge are both true.
by_command.run: JSON ok is true; container id/name, requested and actual ports, image tag, port-file value, and docker inspect label/binding all agree.
by_command.seed-codex-auth: seedResult.codex is exactly seeded or skipped (local is newer), contains no error or skipped-empty state, and the exact live Codex OK probe passes.
by_command.seed-git-auth: All required seed results are seeded, exists, or seeded+enriched; restart is true; health.status is ok; GitRemoteManager and authenticated acquisition probes pass without credential output.
by_command.stop: The prepared container id is absent; the owner never emits removed=true solely because docker rm was attempted.

common: Process return code is zero.
Exactly one command-specific semantic verifier passes.
Exactly one durable owner_terminal event and one matching terminal artifact are emitted for effect_id.
A duplicate identical terminalization returns the existing event; a conflicting or second event fails closed.

contract.derivation: One complete non-composite owner unit under the approved 60-minute-per-atomic-task policy; any retry remains inside productive execution.

policy.effect_identity: delegation_id plus parent_effect_id plus mode plus task_guid plus blocked workflow/run identity plus verified blocker correction
policy.prepare: Persist the deterministic target run/control identity before the operator call and atomically bind delegation consumption to child effect preparation.

reconciliation.restart-workflow: Query deterministic child run identity and task lineage. A matching new workflow run is ALREADY_APPLIED; proved absence with the original blocked run unchanged is NOT_APPLIED; multiple or divergent new runs are INDETERMINATE.
reconciliation.resume: Query the original run. A matching active/waiting/completed post-resume state is ALREADY_APPLIED; the unchanged failed state with no accepted control receipt is NOT_APPLIED; identity disagreement is INDETERMINATE.
reconciliation.start-over: Query deterministic restarted research-run identity under the same task. A matching new run is ALREADY_APPLIED; proved absence with no accepted start-over receipt is NOT_APPLIED; multiple or divergent runs are INDETERMINATE.

policy.resume_rule: An ALREADY_APPLIED running/waiting result returns control to the parent without issuing a second operator action.

common: Process return code is zero.
The operator envelope has no errorCode and does not classify as blocked or unknown.
A durable target run identity is present and belongs to task_guid and the requested/derived workflow.
A semantic state query proves the target run is running, waiting at a recognized gate/clarification, completed, or chain-complete.
The output includes mode, workflow, taskGuid, targetRunId, verdict, finalOk, and errorCode.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and matching terminal artifact exist for child effect_id.

mode_specific.restart-workflow: targetRunId is a new run of workflow_name under task_guid and upstream task lineage remains unchanged.
mode_specific.resume: targetRunId equals the requested run_id and the state no longer represents an unacknowledged failed control action.
mode_specific.start-over: targetRunId is a new research-workflow run under task_guid produced by the acknowledged start-over action.

policy.source_correction: cmd_reenter must return nonzero for blocked/unknown/error envelopes and must emit targetRunId; its current unconditional return zero and omitted run identity cannot terminalize success.

trusted_roots.operator-env-provider: The configured durable local-operator environment provider; represented only by a secret handle
